sources.entry: 17. iSpeech - High-quality text-to-speech and voice recognition.

summary.name: iSpeech
summary.one_liner: iSpeech offers text-to-speech and speech recognition APIs plus open-source TTS and ASR SDKs for adding voice to apps, web content and devices.
use_cases: Adding voice output to mobile apps
Generating IVR phone prompts from text
Converting text into downloadable audio files
Adding speech recognition to embedded or cloud products
summary.what_it_does: The page describes natural-sounding text-to-speech and speech recognition offered through an API and open-source SDKs. It says the speech API supports more than 30 languages. Solutions include custom embedded, cloud and SAPI integrations for text-to-voice and voice recognition. A Chrome app called Select and Speak is advertised for voice-enabling web content. The page also lists voice clones and talking stickers as features.
notable: Speech API supporting more than 30 languages
Select and Speak Chrome app for voice-enabling web pages
caveats: Select and Speak Chrome app is for non-commercial use only
Pricing for the API and commercial use is not stated on the page
